company.name: Rimsys
company.shortDescription: Rimsys is a provider of Regulatory Information Management (RIM) software for medical technology companies.
company.description: Rimsys is a world-leading Regulatory Information Management (RIM) software for medical technology companies. Built by and for regulatory affairs professionals, Rimsys digitizes, automates, and creates regulatory order to ensure products adhere to changing global regulations. It is the only holistic RIM software for medical devices, in-vitro diagnostics, and medical device software that makes it easy to manage global UDI requirements and navigate the pillars of regulatory affairs, including product registration, standards management, essential principles/GSPR, and regulatory intelligence.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based regulatory information management platform for medical technology companies. It centralizes regulatory data and supports registrations, submissions, UDI, essential-principles tables, standards, and regulatory workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Rimsys Platform

productsAndServices.description: A regulatory intelligence service that provides centralized access to market-entry requirements and regulatory information for medical technology companies across global markets.
productsAndServices.name: Rimsys Intel

productsAndServices.description: A suite of AI agents designed for MedTech regulatory teams to automate repetitive regulatory work and support analysis and decision-making.
productsAndServices.name: Rimsys AI

productsAndServices.description: Integration capabilities that connect Rimsys regulatory data with ERP, CRM, PLM, quality, and product-management systems through connectors, developer tools, and change-data capture.
productsAndServices.name: Rimsys Integrations

productsAndServices.description: Implementation and ongoing support services for Rimsys regulatory information management software, including customer assistance, help-center resources, and security and compliance support.
productsAndServices.name: Regulatory Information Management Services and Support
